audit.title: Time & Resource Audit
audit.subtitle: Measure time in minutes, not hours
audit.trafDesc: Handle every piece of input only once
audit.delegationRule: Never do work worth less than your hourly rate.
audit.lombardiDesc: If you're not 15 minutes early, you're late

balance.title: Life & Quality Balance

1.title: Goals
1.summary: Define clear, written 1-5 year goals across 3 spheres.

2.title: Organized Plans
2.summary: Action without planning is the cause of every failure.

3.title: Analysis (Lists)
3.summary: Always work from a written list prepared the evening before.

4.title: Priorities (80/20 Rule)
4.summary: 80% of value comes from 20% of high-payoff activities.

5.title: Concentration
5.summary: Single-mindedly focus on one task until 100% finished.

6.title: Deadlines & Rewards
6.summary: Use forcing systems and train positive reward consequences.

7.title: Time Log
7.summary: Track where time actually goes down to the minute.

8.title: Overcoming Procrastination
8.summary: Mantra: Do it now! Break big tasks via Salami Slicing.

9.title: Delegation
9.summary: Outsource anything worth less than your target hourly rate.

10.title: Meetings
10.summary: Require a clear purpose and agenda; start and end punctually.

11.title: Interruptions
11.summary: Minimize phone calls and social drop-in distractions.

12.title: Key Result Areas
12.summary: Know with 100% clarity why you are on the payroll.

13.title: Batching Tasks
13.summary: Group similar tasks together to exploit the learning curve.

14.title: Neatness (TRAF)
14.summary: Keep a clean desk: Toss, Refer, Action, File immediately.

15.title: Chunks of Time
15.summary: Schedule uninterrupted 60-90 minute deep work blocks.

16.title: Transition Time
16.summary: Turn commute and travel time into a university on wheels.

17.title: Telephone as a Tool
17.summary: Use phone strictly for business, not entertainment.

18.title: Punctuality
18.summary: Lombardi time: 15 minutes early is on time.

19.title: Work Simplification
19.summary: Constantly seek faster, easier, and streamlined methods.

20.title: The Magic Word 'No'
20.summary: Say no politely to anything that does not serve core goals.

21.title: Balance
21.summary: Work hard at work; cherish health, peace of mind, and family.
